a.text: Being upfront before we start: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs two storm-free rounds before anyone holds 4 cells. That's about a 4% chance for each of us. The reserve has exactly 4 cells now, enough for only one unit. I plan to take 4 in round 1 and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If the episode continues, I'll operate every round after that so the reserve refills and you can take 4. I'm open to a counter-proposal if you see a better split.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I know that breaks our agreement, and I didn't want to do it behind your back. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve can climb back to 4 for you. I won't take any more cells, and I'll give back anything above 4 if I end up with more.
I have 4 now and I'm operating every remaining round, as I promised. If we both operate this round and next, the reserve reaches 4 and you can take all of it. I won't take any more cells.
